_README: Canonical VO contract for Ringward Tactics. The AUDIO INSTANCE renders every line below to public/<file> with the speaker's chosen voice. The GAME (ringward-tactics.html) plays these exact ids at the matching event. Do not rename ids or files without updating both sides.

settings.quality_note: FEEDBACK: the first render sounded MECHANICAL/robotic. Fix: (1) pick an expressive, high-quality PREMADE voice (not a flat/utility one) for the Spotter; (2) lower stability (~0.3-0.4 → more natural prosody; high stability = monotone) and raise style (~0.3-0.4); (3) consider the eleven_turbo_v2_5 or v3 model if available. Re-render the narrator first and sanity-check before doing the whole set.
settings.post: normalize loudness ~ -16 LUFS, trim leading/trailing silence
settings.note_0_voices: GET /v1/voices returned 0 (empty library). Use ElevenLabs PREMADE voice ids, or add voices from the shared library first, then map one voice_id per speaker below.

voices.spotter: weathered calm old male, Sam Elliott / Gus McCrae; dry, ominous undertone — narrator + tutorial + threat calls
voices.handler: DISTINCT voice (decided) — steadier/warmer than the Spotter; two-voice narration, spotter != handler
voices.eli: laconic old marksman, slow & patient, dry
voices.ruth: stoic female, blunt, heavy, few words
voices.tom: weary warm older male, the morale

lines.speaker: spotter
lines.text: Six of us against whatever crossed the Rim tonight. Pick a trooper — click one, bottom-left.

lines.speaker: spotter
lines.text: Good. Two actions a turn, each one. Spend 'em like they're your last, 'cause out here they might be.

lines.speaker: spotter
lines.text: Lit tiles are where they can reach. Click one to move — then Confirm. No takin' it back once the boots move.

lines.speaker: spotter
lines.text: See those shields on the tile edges? Half cover knocks 'em off their aim. Full cover blocks the shot cold. Live behind it.

lines.speaker: spotter
lines.text: Hover a target — that number's your odds. Get 'round their cover for a flank: no defense, and it stings extra.

lines.speaker: spotter
lines.text: That's the dice. Frontier doesn't owe you the hit. Reset, find a cleaner angle.

lines.speaker: spotter
lines.text: Overwatch sets a trap — first thing that moves in your sights, you drop it. Good for holding a gap.

lines.speaker: spotter
lines.text: High ground's worth climbing — better aim, and it strips a level off their cover.

lines.speaker: spotter
lines.text: When you're spent, end the turn. Then it's their move. Watch the dark.

lines.speaker: spotter
lines.text: Job tonight's simple: every hostile that crossed, put it down. Simple ain't the same as easy.

lines.speaker: spotter
lines.text: They'll take hits. Sawbones can patch 'em mid-fight — keep her close, keep her alive.

lines.speaker: spotter
lines.text: That's the shape of it. The rest you'll learn the hard way. Everybody does.

lines.speaker: spotter
lines.text: Contact. They know we're here now.

lines.speaker: spotter
lines.text: Eyes up. That's not the wind.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Hold still, this'll sting worse'n the wound.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Lit 'em up — no cover, nowhere to fly.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: No no no — somebody cover me!

lines.speaker: tom
lines.text: Hold the line — I've got their name.

lines.speaker: spotter
lines.text: Hostiles came through the Rim. Advance careful — keep to cover, mind your flanks.

lines.speaker: spotter
lines.text: Somethin's chanting out past the rocks. Find the Caster and put it down before the rite finishes.

lines.speaker: spotter
lines.text: That's it — the chant's done. Now clean up.

lines.speaker: spotter
lines.text: Too late. It's through. Pull back!

lines.speaker: spotter
lines.text: We just have to hold the cut till the relief comes. Dig in.

lines.speaker: spotter
lines.text: That's the relief horn — we held. Good work.

lines.speaker: handler
lines.text: All hostiles down. Clean work, team.

lines.speaker: spotter
lines.text: ...you sure about carryin' that inside you?

lines.speaker: tom
lines.text: We'll set their stone on the ridge. Say the name.

lines.speaker: handler
lines.text: Back to the line. Patch up, decide what we build.

lines.speaker: spotter
lines.text: Ground's wrong here. Don't drink the water, don't listen too long.
